anya: Quick heads-up — onboarding Volantis17b (int4) to dedicated. Quant run looked ok perf-wise but we saw a small quality regression on long-form summarization when default max_new_tokens bumped above 200.

mike: Repro'd on eval harness? Which metric moved and by how much?

anya: Ran 5k-prompt suite (mix of short/long). ROUGE-L dropped ~2.6% and a learned RL-scoring proxy fell 3.1% vs int8 baseline for prompts with >250 generated tokens. Short gens unaffected.

leo: Any memory/OOMs tied to this? Could be batching interplay with truncation/kv behavior.

anya: No OOMs. Perf looks good: p95 latency down ~10% with int4. But quality delta is concerning for long outputs.

sam: Configs used during eval? Were we using `kv_prefetch=true` or any warmstart tweaks?

anya: Canary config used:
```
route: volantis-17b-int4-canary
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 300
  batch_limit: 8
  kv_prefetch: true
  slot_compactor: normal
  warmstart_reserve_mb: 200
```

mike: Can we A/B by holding model constant and toggling `kv_prefetch` and `max_new_tokens`? Need to isolate quantization vs decoding settings.

leo: Good call. My hunch: prefetch + long gen may change tokenization/segmentation timing and occasionally hit fallback kernels that slightly alter sampling RNG state for temperature/beam? Weird but plausible. We'll run three variants: (A) int4 prefetched (current), (B) int4 no-prefetch, (C) int8 baseline. Use same random seed / sampling config for determinism.

anya: Running those A/B/C now across 1k long prompts each. Will post numbers.

[10m later]

anya: Results: A (int4+prefetch): ROUGE-L -2.7%, RL-proxy -3.0%. B (int4+no-prefetch): ROUGE-L -0.9%, RL-proxy -1.0%. C (int8): baseline.

mike: So most of the hit comes from kv_prefetch interaction, not int4 itself. Interesting. Could be timing/attention kernel path or slight temperature drift.

leo: We should try `kv_prefetch=false` as default for Volantis17b int4 and rerun larger eval (5k). Also capture internal RNG state / sampling calls to confirm determinism.

anya: Raising a tiny rollout: change canary defaults to max_new_tokens=250, kv_prefetch=false, batch_limit=6. Will run 5k eval and a 15m synthetic load.

deploy-bot: Canary config update applied to volantis-17b-int4-canary by anya at 2024-09-12T16:10:05Z :rocket:

[after tests]

anya: 5k eval: ROUGE-L delta now -0.8%, RL-proxy -0.9%. Perf tradeoff: p95 latency +2% vs previous int4 prefetched setup but still ~7% faster than int8 baseline. No OOMs observed in 15m stress run at 2x QPS.

mike: That's within our 2% guard for quality, so acceptable. Document the kv_prefetch caveat in model notes.

leo: I'll add an automated check in the onboarding harness: when enabling prefetch for int4, run a quick long-gen eval to detect quality drift >1.5% before flipping it. Also add a debug flag to log kernel fallback counts.

sam: Good. Follow-ups: (1) add model doc entry that Volantis int4 defaults kv_prefetch=false for long-gen workloads; (2) consider a runtime probe to detect prefetch-induced sampling divergences.

anya: Filed docs + issue. Thanks all :heart:

deploy-bot: Canary passed eval + smoke checks at 2024-09-12T16:36:40Z.
